definitions.gloss: horse riding; mounting a horse; being mounted
definitions.explanation: The act of riding on horseback, or the state of being mounted on a horse.

examples.japanese: ⟦{騎手|きしゅ}→騎手：21820_kishu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{騎乗|きじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{騎乗|きじょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧まま⟦{弓|ゆみ}→弓：08430_yumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{射|い}た。
examples.english: The samurai shot an arrow while mounted on horseback.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{騎乗|きじょう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧よう、インストラクター⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The instructor carefully guides even beginners so they can ride safely.

notes:
A compound of {騎|き} (to ride, mounted) and {乗|じょう} (to ride, to mount). Used in formal and technical contexts related to horseback riding, equestrian sports, and horse racing. In everyday conversation, ⟦{馬|うま}→馬：01865_uma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ is more common.

The word appears frequently in horse racing (⟦{競馬|けいば}→競馬：00207_keiba⟧), where jockeys (⟦{騎手|きしゅ}→騎手：21820_kishu⟧) are described as {騎乗|きじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, and in historical contexts about mounted warriors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {騎乗|きじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mount, to ride
- {騎乗|きじょう}⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: riding posture
- {騎乗|きじょう}⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: horseback riding experience
- {騎乗|きじょう}⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧: riding suspension (horse racing penalty)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗馬|じょうば}→乗馬：17123_jouba⟧: horseback riding — the general term for recreational or sport riding
- ⟦{騎馬|きば}→騎馬：24597_kiba⟧: mounted on horseback — emphasizes the military or ceremonial aspect
- {馬術|ばじゅつ}: equestrian art; horsemanship — the formal discipline of riding
